decisions.reason: As the replacement for an established voltage measurement module in the core platform, it likely has proven demand and is worth retaining unless a newer revision is imminent.
The MQTT proxy is a low-cost software complement that broadens integration options, so it remains sensible to keep while its ecosystem value exceeds its modest maintenance burden.
A CAN bus interface fits important German automation and embedded use cases, and after several years its strategic platform role still justifies keeping it on the market.
The CO2 sensor module still adds relevant sensing coverage, but narrower demand and component-related hardware risk make it more vulnerable than the firm's core interface and measurement modules.

After several years, a peripheral touch panel accessory with limited strategic importance is the kind of option we would close if uptake has not clearly justified ongoing catalog, support, and inventory effort.
